description: Use this skill when configuring or troubleshooting the Salesforce CPQ Guided Selling wizard: Quote Process records, ProcessInput questions that filter products by field value, mapping answers to Product2 classification fields, and search type choice (Standard, Enhanced, Custom). Trigger keywords: CPQ guided selling, quote process wizard, product selection wizard, SBQQ__QuoteProcess__c, SBQQ__ProcessInput__c, guided product selection, auto select product, product search plugin. NOT for bundles, product options, or product rules — use admin/cpq-product-catalog-setup. NOT for writing a custom ProductSearchPlugin in Apex — use apex/cpq-apex-plugins.
inputs: List of questions the wizard should ask reps (labels, field types, and allowed values)
Product2 classification fields that answers will filter against (API names and data types)
Whether the org uses Standard search, Enhanced multi-select search, or a Custom Apex search plugin
Whether Auto Select Product should be enabled (single-match auto-add behavior)
Whether the Quote Process should be the org-wide default or pricebook-specific
Existing SBQQ__QuoteProcess__c and SBQQ__ProcessInput__c record structure if troubleshooting
name: cpq-guided-selling
official_sources: Salesforce CPQ Plugins Developer Guide, Summer '26: https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/cpq_plugins.pdf (product search plugin overview L1003-1013; product search interface methods and sample L1017-1345; guided selling interface, order of execution, methods, and sample L1347-1640; product configuration initializer for guided selling L2703-2780; product search executor for guided selling L2803-2840)

Salesforce CPQ Developer Guide, Summer '26: https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/cpq_developer_guide.pdf (no new feature development and Revenue Cloud recommendation L32-36; quote model JSON with `SBQQ__QuoteProcessId__c` L950-975; pointer to the CPQ Plugins guide L3303-3305)
Metadata API Developer Guide, Summer '26: https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf (CustomField and ApexClass metadata used in `metadata-examples.md`)
Create a Quote Process for Guided Selling: https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.cpq_quote_process.htm
CPQ Developer Guide: Product Configuration Initializer (atlas HTML): https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.cpq_dev_guide.meta/cpq_dev_guide/cpq_dev_product_config_initializer.htm
outputs: SBQQ__QuoteProcess__c record configured for guided selling
SBQQ__ProcessInput__c records mapping each wizard question to a Product2 classification field
Mirrored custom fields on SBQQ__ProcessInput__c matching Product2 API names (if custom fields used)
Documented search type choice and rationale
